evidence.quote: In short, "gradual and low" is likely to be the new normal.
The persistent weakness in core price inflation deserves continued vigilance.
we should be cautious about raising rates, do so gradually, and carefully assess the effects on economic and financial conditions as we go.
it would be prudent to maintain reinvestments until the normalization of the federal funds rate is sufficiently far along to allow room to cut nominal rates if economic conditions deteriorate.
the U.S. economy is growing at a pace only modestly above potential while core inflation remains restrained
the asymmetry in risk-management considerations counsels a cautious and gradual approach.
